name: ellipse-carousel
title: Ellipse Carousel
description: Elliptical card carousel with autoplay, drag interaction, mobile-specific ellipse tuning, and an optional center label.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background fill behind the carousel stage.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Text shown at the center of the ellipse when enabled.

props.name: showCenterLabel
props.description: Shows or hides the center label.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Card width at the largest active position, in pixels.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Card height at the largest active position, in pixels.

props.name: minScale
props.description: Minimum scale applied to the farthest cards on the ellipse.

props.name: radiusXRatio
props.description: Horizontal ellipse radius as a fraction of the stage width.

props.name: radiusYRatio
props.description: Vertical ellipse radius as a fraction of the stage height.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Automatically advances the carousel by one card at a time.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Seconds to hold on the active card before advancing.

props.name: stepDuration
props.description: Seconds for the snap transition between cards.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses autoplay while hovering a card.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Allows users to drag the ellipse by hand.

props.name: dragSensitivity
props.description: Multiplier on the carousel's angular drag response.
